preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value is between 1 and 200,000.
There are exactly n-1 edges forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and 1 <= i <= 2 * 10**5 for i in output.keys())
postconditions.description: Output keys are integers between 1 and 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count > 0 for count in output.values())
postconditions.description: Output values are positive integers representing counts of pairs.

postconditions.expression: all((x, y) in pairs for i, count in output.items() for x, y in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(1, n + 1), 2) if gcd(a[x-1], a[y-1]) == i)
postconditions.description: For each output pair (i, count), there are exactly 'count' pairs (x, y) such that gcd(a[x-1], a[y-1]) == i.
